rules.modality_gestural: Codebook 1 -- gestural is a communicative gesture, not physical handling; multimodal needs two message-bearing channels; unknown vs none
rules.outcome_target: Codebook 2 -- correct/incorrect/partial/no_response need an identifiable target; absent acknowledgement is unknown, not incorrect
rules.prompt_antecedent: Codebook 3 -- the turn creating the opportunity is an antecedent, not a prompt; child-initiated is independent; most-supportive level wins
